title: From Textual Information Sources to Linked Data in the Agatha Project
answer_short: by its ability to populate a specialized ontology for criminal law and link entities to external referents, forming a linked data knowledge base
answer_rationale: The pipeline's effectiveness is evaluated based on its capability to populate a specialized ontology for criminal law and link entities to external referents, creating a linked data knowledge base. This is explicitly stated in Text 5, which describes the Agatha project's results, and supported by Text 2, which mentions the use of NLP modules to populate an ontology for criminal investigations. The evaluation is tied to the successful extraction and representation of events, agents, and other elements in a structured, linked data format.
